title: potentilla norvegica subsp. hirsuta
intro: Potentilla norvegica subsp. hirsuta, commonly known as hairy cinquefoil, is a subspecies of perennial herb in the rose family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of hairy cinquefoil are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and potentially lower blood sugar levels. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects are thought to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified in various studies on the plant.
